description: Reading of the retrieval misses in eval/results/retrieval_eval_20261023T180901Z_eec1643166.json against the corpus (data/extracted_json/ncert_chunks.json): whether the corpus holds the content (retriever miss) or not (corpus gap), and the Class 2 pattern.

misses_outside_top_5.note: Class 4 'Jugs and Mugs' pages 101-112 cover fractions; the bare one-word query returns Class 3 pages instead. The longer 'what is a fraction of a whole' (rq-003) ranks the right pages first.
The Class 4 chapter names and compares fractions but never adds unlike fractions; page 102 is only the nearest grounding.
Class 2 pages 33-37 are the 'Counting in Tens' chapter; the top results are Class 1 teacher's notes (pages 142 and 152).

class_2_pattern.note: Class 2 searches also cover Class 1, and the Class 1 book ends with teacher-facing notes that use the same topic words as the chapters (subtraction, patterns, measurement), so they outrank the Class 2 pages.
